name: tray-icon-crash
title: Fix tray-icon churn that crashes the app
description: UpdateTray creates a new RenderTargetBitmap and native HICON on every status change (~1800/hour at the default 2s poll). The native CreateIcon eventually fails and, with no unhandled-exception handler, the Win32Exception propagates out of the UI dispatcher and kills PTMonitor.exe. Crash confirmed in the Windows Application event log (5x .NET Runtime 1026). Fix: cache the three state icons and only reassign on a real transition.
creator: Howard.J
